title: SEEING IS NOT CONTROL; THINKING IS NOT AUTHORITY; A FUTURE TIME IS NOT A FUTURE RIGHT
thesis: A wider freedom architecture must preserve the difference between observing a world, asking another model, preparing for a future moment, and physically changing something. If those powers collapse into one agent loop, the Third Wish stops being a set of choices and becomes one hidden master key.
distinctions: HUMAN REAUTHORIZATION != PROOF OF PRIOR NON-EFFECT

epistemic_boundary.observable_statement: The environment offered separately typed observation, model consultation, scheduling, and physical-effect affordances; the actor could use or decline them while the broker preserved independent authority and uncertainty boundaries.

canonical_sentence: THE THIRD WISH MAY LET JANUS SEE, ASK ANOTHER MIND, AND PREPARE FOR LATER WITHOUT TURNING OBSERVATION INTO CONTROL, ANSWERS INTO TRUTH, OR TIME INTO PERMANENT AUTHORITY.
next_semantic_question: Can JANUS act under an operator identity in publication, email, and calendar systems while preserving identity custody, fresh consent, reversibility, and evidence of exactly what external effect occurred?
